data.exact_reserve_text: An adverse run off deviation of GBP 1.5m (2017: favourable run off deviation of GBP 0.8m) was experienced during the year, wholly in respect of reserve movements on the 2012, 2013, 2014 and 2015 year of account Whole Account Quota Share contracts with Syndicate 2003 and the Legacy Catlin Group entities.

prior_year_events.event_name: Whole Account Quota Share reserve movements (Syndicate 2003 / Legacy Catlin Group)
prior_year_events.impact_description: Adverse run off deviation wholly in respect of reserve movements on the 2012, 2013, 2014 and 2015 years of account for Whole Account Quota Share contracts with Syndicate 2003 and Legacy Catlin Group entities.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2088 reported an adverse prior-year reserve development of GBP 1.5m in 2018 (strengthening), arising wholly from reserve movements on the 2012-2015 years of account related to Whole Account Quota Share contracts with Syndicate 2003 and legacy Catlin entities. The movement is small relative to opening gross reserves (approximately 0.87% of opening gross claims outstanding) and has been classified as adverse claims development affecting treaty/quota-share business.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (GBP 1.5m) taken from Note 6 narrative 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' which explicitly states the amount but does not present a labelled gross/reinsurer split in the same sentence; treated as gross movement per note heading. A gross claims development triangle is available (see page 31) but contains a '2013 & Prior' aggregated column (excluded from triangle-based PYD calculations) and the movement note is the primary source. Confidence lowered from 1.0 to 0.8 for the prior-year movement due to absence of an explicit labelled 'Insurance liabilities' column adjacent to the quoted figure.
